messages.text: BL-2064 🎵 in progress — A local seat that reads without writing is told to write, then restarted: since 2026-10-04 61% of the iq3 coder's model time went to read-only calls and 39% was reading a compaction discarded before any edit; the repeat guard tells the seat to write at its 12th read since the last write and restarts it at the 24th, on the same per-parcel restart count as a missed write
